"""Diacritic removal."""

from __future__ import annotations

import unicodedata


def strip_accents(text: str) -> str:
    """Remove diacritical marks (accents) from ``text``.

    ``"café"`` becomes ``"cafe"``. Characters that carry no diacritic are
    returned unchanged, including non-Latin text (e.g. ``"日本語"``) and
    base letters that would not survive a naive ASCII round trip (e.g. ``ß``).

    The text is decomposed (NFD) so that both precomposed characters
    (``"é"``) and an accent written as a separate combining character
    (``"e\\u0301"``) are handled the same way: the base letter is kept and
    the combining marks are dropped.

    Args:
        text: Input text.

    Returns:
        ``text`` without diacritical marks.
    """
    decomposed = unicodedata.normalize("NFD", text)
    return "".join(ch for ch in decomposed if not _is_combining_mark(ch))


def _is_combining_mark(ch: str) -> bool:
    """Return True if ``ch`` is a Unicode combining diacritical mark."""
    return unicodedata.category(ch).startswith("M")
